domain: High-Frequency Trading Matching Engine & Direct Market Access
title: AuroraX Exchange Sub-Microsecond Colocation and Direct Market Access Deal - $18.5M over 3 Years
executive_summary: AuroraX proposes a $18.5M 3-year colocated FPGA tick-to-trade solution for a principal trading firm requiring deterministic sub-microsecond access to CME and Nasdaq. The deal promises 450-nanosecond latency with 100% uptime, which engineering specifications materially qualify and limit.

proposal_document.title: Commercial Proposal v1.0
proposal_document.text:
Our Ultra-Low Latency Colocation solution guarantees 450-nanosecond deterministic tick-to-trade latency at the 99.99th percentile for all CME and Nasdaq direct feeds, with zero packet loss and 100% uptime SLA including during market open volatility spikes. We provide dedicated FPGA-accelerated matching engine access with unlimited order throughput at 40 million messages per second and pre-trade risk checks completed in under 100 nanoseconds with no added jitter.

The service includes 24/7 dedicated fiber cross-connects with automatic failover in under 50 milliseconds, full historical tick data replay at no extra cost, and guaranteed co-location cabinet power and cooling with no scheduled maintenance downtime ever required. Our compliance package ensures full MiFID II and Reg SCI certification with real-time surveillance alerts delivered within 1 second of any anomaly.

technical_specification.title: Technical Architecture Spec v4.2
technical_specification.text:
The matching engine operates on Solarflare X2 NICs with DPDK bypass, delivering median tick-to-trade latency of 890 nanoseconds and 99th percentile latency of 1.8 microseconds under 5 million messages per second load; throughput is hard-capped at 8 million messages per second per gateway with throttling thereafter. Pre-trade risk checks are performed in software requiring 350-600 nanoseconds, adding 120 nanoseconds of jitter under burst conditions, with packet loss of 0.001% tolerated during peak volatility (e.g., FOMC, CPI prints).

Colocation cabinets require a weekly 4-hour scheduled maintenance window every Sunday 00:00-04:00 ET during which matching engine access and market data feeds are unavailable, yielding a 98.5% platform availability target excluding exchange-mandated halts. Cross-connect failover is best-effort with 800ms-1.2s convergence via BGP, audit logging is batch-processed every 15 minutes with surveillance alerts generated within 5 minutes, and historical tick data replay is limited to 30 days retention and billed at $15,000 per TB requested.

commitments.claim: 450-nanosecond deterministic tick-to-trade latency at 99.99th percentile with zero packet loss and 100% uptime
commitments.proposal_quote: guarantees 450-nanosecond deterministic tick-to-trade latency at the 99.99th percentile for all CME and Nasdaq direct feeds, with zero packet loss and 100% uptime SLA including during market open volatility spikes
commitments.spec_quote: delivering median tick-to-trade latency of 890 nanoseconds and 99th percentile latency of 1.8 microseconds under 5 million messages per second load
commitments.explanation: Spec shows 2x worse median (890ns vs 450ns) and 4x worse tail (1.8 microseconds at only 99th vs promised 99.99th), plus admits 0.001% loss and only 98.5% availability with weekly outages, directly contradicting zero loss and 100% uptime.

commitments.claim: Full MiFID II and Reg SCI certification with 1-second real-time surveillance alerts
commitments.proposal_quote: Our compliance package ensures full MiFID II and Reg SCI certification with real-time surveillance alerts delivered within 1 second of any anomaly
commitments.explanation: Spec never mentions MiFID II or Reg SCI certification and describes only batch audit logging every 15 minutes with alerts within 5 minutes, providing no support for certification or 1-second SLA.

commitments.proposal_quote: We provide dedicated FPGA-accelerated matching engine access
commitments.spec_quote: The matching engine operates on Solarflare X2 NICs with DPDK bypass
commitments.explanation: Spec describes a different acceleration stack (Solarflare NICs + DPDK software bypass, not FPGA) and never defines 'dedicated' - unclear if dedicated gateway, dedicated server, shared FPGA, or paid add-on - leaving scope, hardware, and isolation uncertain.

commitments.claim: Historical tick data replay service is available
commitments.spec_quote: historical tick data replay is limited to 30 days retention
commitments.explanation: Spec explicitly confirms the replay capability exists with 30-day retention, supporting the core proposal claim that replay is provided.
